prelaunch_freshness: Before launch, preserve the complete prior controller result and its exact bytes/hash/run_id when present.

The controller truncates and verifies zero bytes at ux0:data/vitacheat-foreign-target-result.json before writing schema vitacheat.foreign-target-gate.result.v3 with build_id VCFG-RESULT-V3, a nonzero run_id, and a passing clear-controller-result test.
An exact preserved prior result is stale waiting evidence, not an anomaly. Ignore it until an empty observation or a complete current-identity document appears.

A complete current result is fresh only when schema/build/title/firmware/scope match, run_id is nonzero and differs from a preserved v3 run_id, and clear-controller-result passed. A new complete result may be accepted without observing the transient empty file.
Preserve partial current writes and poll read-only. Reject a structurally complete malformed/current-identity mismatch; never infer tests from a partial document.
Before each generation the controller truncates and verifies zero bytes at ux0:data/vitacheat-foreign-target-layout.bin.
Before each generation the controller truncates and verifies zero bytes at ux0:data/vitacheat-foreign-target-startup.bin.
Before each generation the controller truncates and verifies zero bytes at ux0:data/vitacheat-foreign-target-fixture.json.
Any cleanup/open/close/readback failure is recorded and stops before launch.
run: Preserve the prior controller result before launch. During launch polling, treat its exact bytes/hash as stale waiting evidence rather than a test-order failure.

Require a complete current controller v3 result with exact build/schema/run identity and passing clear-controller-result; preserve its pre-target status-v2 diagnostic baseline, then allow the controller to verify target-unavailable, clear all three target evidence paths, and launch VCFT00001.
Poll the startup-stage path read-only. Preserve every distinct invalid/partial byte sequence and continue polling without input.

Require one complete valid v2 prompt-ready record with exact build/title/schema identity, sentinel result 0, wrong-caller last result -12, readiness probe result 0, exactly one attempt, bounded elapsed time, layout result 0, and fixture result 0. Any delayed -13 to -12 transition contradicts create-before-user-entry and stops before input.
Require the exact 32-byte layout and complete fixture JSON independently; the startup record alone is never target-start or read authority.
Send exactly one documented bounded input: press cross; wait 100ms; release cross.

After resume, require the controller's kernel status-v2 evidence for generation 1: exactly one target-create match and authorization delta, at least one create callback delta, at least 19 start callback and successful same-PID revalidation deltas, no saturation, and a final successful start-revalidated lifecycle stage. Only then allow open/read.
Allow VCFC00001 to require kernel TARGET_STARTED, read, destroy only VCFT00001, prove a successful exit lifecycle stage, and verify the stale handle.
Allow VCFC00001 to clear all three target evidence paths and relaunch VCFT00001.
Repeat the prompt-ready validation and one bounded X input for generation 2, then require the same status-v2 deltas from the generation-1-exit baseline before open/read.
Retrieve controller JSON, fixture JSON, startup records/partials, layouts, and all available serial lines beginning VCFG.
